> Weaver does not get to become more capable by becoming less trustworthy.

## Weaver Constitution Check (§7.4)

**Non-custodial**
- [ ] Does not custody funds
- [ ] Does not handle private keys or seed phrases
- [ ] Does not introduce automated signing or autonomous execution

**Transparency**
- [ ] New score/verdict surfaces expose reasoning, not only the number

**Evidence**
- [ ] Material claims are traceable to source
- [ ] Observed data distinguished from inference
- [ ] AI does not generate unverifiable factual claims

**Financial safety**
- [ ] No directive language ("buy now", "you should")
- [ ] No guaranteed-return or FOMO framing

**Conflicts**
- [ ] No payment path can influence a score or suppress a risk flag
- [ ] Sponsored content, if introduced, is clearly separated from organic rankings

**Privacy**
- [ ] No user data transmitted externally without explicit separate opt-in

**Chain parity**
- [ ] Any new discoverable chain has a corresponding Shield adapter

**Reliability**
- [ ] External dependency failures degrade gracefully
- [ ] Repeated API calls are cached with an appropriate TTL

**Scoring**
- [ ] Scoring version bumped if scoring changed
- [ ] Historical results preserved (no retroactive rescoring)

**Community**
- [ ] Losses are equally visible with wins
- [ ] Historical calls are immutable

**UX**
- [ ] Primary workflow is clearer, not noisier
- [ ] Risks are easy to find
- [ ] Mobile layout works
- [ ] Accessibility preserved (keyboard, contrast, labels)
